content.short: Cactus Custody is a qualified custodian for digital assets serving institutions.
content.description: Cactus Custody is a qualified digital asset custodian, holding a Hong Kong TCSP licence, that provides institutions with secure storage plus trading, DeFi and earning tools inside an enterprise management system. Stable's official ecosystem page lists it among custody partners.
content.meta: Cactus Custody is a licensed qualified custodian for institutional digital assets, listed on Stable.
